statements.note: The 'new feature' part is supported: the PR adds a new dotnet-csproj-cataloger (new file parse_csproj.go, registered in cataloger.go and package_tasks.go). Whether it is non-breaking is an impact claim not settled by a concrete check: no public name is removed or renamed, but the cataloger is enabled by default for directory scans so scan output for directories containing .csproj files will now include extra packages, and the default-cataloger list changed; no CI result exists (PR open, no check runs) and the Go test suite/golden-file tests were not run. go.mod also bumps go-diskfs and testify (dependency changes).
